title: Remodeled modern 1 bed with washer/dryer and parking, 99 WalkScore!
body:
Lease Terms:

$3999/month, deposit $3999 and 1 year lease. Water, sewer and garbage are included with rent, parking available.


About the Flat

Very special, fully remodeled one bedroom unit with parking garage available in coveted Mission district on the cusp of Noe Valley, located at 257 San Jose Avenue between 24th and 25th Street. Very well located with an impressive 99 Walk Score, 84 Transit Score and 98 Bike Score! Designer finishes and everything updated throughout, fully remodeled bathroom with standing shower, tile flooring and custom tile walls. Fully remodeled kitchen with stainless-steel appliance suite with refrigerator, dishwasher, gas range, washer/dryer in unit and covered in engineered wood flooring throughout the entire flat! Close to public transportation, tech shuttles, easy access to BART. Very close to everything, easy walk to 18th, 24th, Valencia and Mission Street shopping and restaurants. Walking distance to hidden gem Juri Commons Park, Garfield Square, and Mission Dolores Park! The famous Papalote Mexican and Arizmendi Bakery and top rated Hi Hat Pizza are all right around the corner!!

Kitchen and Living Area Fully remodeled with great countertop space and modern cabinetry, custom backsplash, stainless-steel appliances including large refrigerator, dishwasher gas range and in-unit washer/dryer! Large living space covered in engineered wood flooring!

Bedroom/Bathroom – Large bedroom covered in engineered wood flooring, sliding closet door! Fully remodeled complete with custom tile walls, custom vanity, mirror storage cabinet, and fixtures, Panasonic vent fan and updated fixtures. Standing shower with glass enclosure and all matching chrome designer hardware finishes!


About the Location

Pretty much close to everything you can possibly want, location does not get any better than this, 99 WalkScore! Located on the great block of San Jose Avenue on the cusp of Noe Valley! Very desirable location on San Jose Avenue between 24th and 25th Street in the Mission! Walk, bike, scooter to all conveniences with easy access to public transportation and car sharing stations. Around the corner from the famous Arizmendi Bakery, Papalote restaurant, Barstool Pizza Review 8.2 Dave rated Hi Hat Pizza very close and jus a couple blocks away from Mission and also Valencia Street restaurants, bars and shops!! Close to lots of public transportation, very close to 24th St and Mission BART, multiple bus stops and one at 24th and Valencia just around the corner, rail line a couple blocks away, 99 Walk, 84 Transit and 98 Bike Scores!

Close to great restaurants, bars and coffee shops nearby include, Arizmendi Bakery, Papalote Mexican, Haus Coffee, Hi Hat Pizza. Flour + Water, Funky Elephant, Reem's Mission, Lazy Bear Dandelion Chooclate, Bottega, Delam Persian, Beretta Valencia, Foreign Cinema, Ritual Coffee Wise Sons Fiore Caffe, , Al’s Place, Clooney’s Pub, Anthony’s Cookies, PI Bar, The Little Spot Cafe, Arizmendi Bakery, Jump Start Deli and Grocery, The Laundry Café, Dovre Club, Humphry Slocombe Ice Cream, Old Jerusalem, Big Mouth Burgers, Phat Philly, Beloved Natural Cafe & Organic Juicery, Café Valencia, Beretta, Third Culture Bakery, Bottega, Taqueria El Farolito, La Taqueria, Red Café, La Corneta Taqueria, The Napper Trandy, Jelly Donut, Wise Sons Jewish Deli, Philz Coffee, The Pizza Shop and many more!


Rental Qualifications

In addition to the information required on the application, income equaling 3 times the monthly rent, positive rental history, positive credit history with minimum 700 credit scores, renters’ insurance with liability insurance, in an amount not less than $300k, with Housing Provider as additional interest are all requirements. Security deposit is based on credit, minimum security deposit is listed above. All adults must view the flat in person and submit an application.

title: Bright top floor impressive western views condo on a great block
body: Spacious bright top floor view condo on a great block. Living room has handsome fireplace & details. Nice dining room with impressive western views. Home has period detail hardwood floors w/inlay, French doors, baseboard molding and bay windows. Kitchen is bright w/newer stainless appliances, cabinets, gas range, good prepping space + views. Office space nook, private entry + in unit laundry make this ++. Independent garage space is spacious w/bonus parking in front of the garage for guests. There is a large exclusive storage room with window and 2nd storage area. Home is minutes to all the Mission's best cafes, shops, parks + activities. Close to mass transit, corporate shuttle easy freeway access. A Walker+Biker Paradise 95 Walkscore.

title: Special top floor 1BR condo with light-filled and stunning views
body: This special top floor condo has stunning views, a light-filled floor plan and a desirable location near the heart of Noe Valley and the Mission. It's in a gorgeous 1920's 6 unit corner building set on one of the highest points of palm tree-lined Dolores Street, one of the most iconic and coveted streets in San Francisco. With its impressive views from most of its rooms, great natural light, scale and smart layout, this 1 bedroom plus office condo feels larger than its square footage. It features a spacious living room, inviting bedroom, nice-sized kitchen and dining area, cozy office, bright bathroom, beautiful foyer and more closet space than most one bedrooms. Period details, hardwood floors, common laundry, a shared terrace and a private 1 car garage with additional storage complete this home. no HOA dues. Near numerous popular restaurants, cafes, shops, nightlife, Dolores Park, MUNI and BART. This well designed home can be your oasis in the city. The one you've been waiting for.

title: Cozy Sunny Top floor in the Mission
